GUIDE: Dev Tools --> Application Tab

Open the dev tools tab with CTRL + SHIFT + J and navigate to the application tab. In firefox, be sure to use CTRL + SHIFT + I

The browser's temporary files, references, and objects reveal the [before] transparent inner-workings of the current domain.

Examples are using Edge browser. Chrome and Firefox use similar keyboard shortcuts and application layout information.

Service workers may only be removed manually by uninstalling them in the application tab page.

Sources:

  • How To Uninstall, Unregister Or Remove A Service Worker
  • What you should know before making a service worker
